title: Senegalese words and phrases
summary: She gives a few Senegalese words (avadra, 'good morning') and tries to recall dance songs like Kalinda.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band names

blocks.x: I wanted to ask you about some Senegalese words too. You told me Avadra was one, wasn't that one? How do you say good for nothing in Senegalese?
In what? Senegal. Avadra. Avadra is good for nothing. What about Good Morning?
Would those be in any of the songs? Would those words be in any of the songs?
No, never. I don't remember. But I know the Good Morning is Salikam Seram. And how is everybody here? It's Pelemete Dumbaya Kayaka.
Do you remember any of the songs that went with some of the dances like the Bambuma or the Kalinda or the Kungjain?
Oui, you can you sing a little about that? Don't say Kalinda, Bujun, Bujun. Mr. Pila or Cops. I'm going to hear something. I'm going to hear something.

I know, tous les jours dimanche, that's creole. Tous les jours dimanche, it's coming sometime. Tous les jours, c'est fait. Tous les jours, t'embouillaka yavaka. Ça n'a fait pour ça. As much as I know, I can't remember. Just cannot remember.
